name: PACS
description: Domain-generalization classification benchmark with four domains (Photo, Art Painting, Cartoon, and Sketch) and seven classes, comprising about 10,000 images. Commonly evaluated using leave-one-domain-out accuracy. Open research terms; no data is vendored here.
citation: Li, D., Yang, Y., Song, Y.-Z., & Hospedales, T. M. (2017). Deeper, Broader and Artier Domain Generalization. IEEE International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV). (PACS)

license.identifier: Open research terms; no SPDX license identifier stated
